comment: Best teacher ever! So engaging and explains concepts so clearly. Loved this class!

Dr. Miller is a great professor. His lectures are interesting and he makes all topics very easy to understand, although participation isn't really necessary if you do the textbook readings. His tests are fair and really easy if you do his study guides. An A is very manageable, overall great guy, take this class

Really interesting lectures and clear grading requirements. Midterm, final, and research proposal were the main assignments. Nothing really difficult. The readings are interesting but you don't really have to do them. Really enjoyed his class

Prof Miller knows what he's talking about, is straight forward, and is pretty funny. Mostly lectures with all info on slides. After third week I stopped doing reading and was fine. For group presentations I didn't read the whole book only the chapter I was assigned. Pretty basic class, easy A if you study, attendance isn't mandatory which was nice.
Fun and easy class with incredible lectures that challenge your thinking.

Derek Miller has super interesting lectures. Half the time you don't even have to do the assigned reading for class. He has clear expectations and gives study guides for mid-terms and finals making his class even easier. He's funny too.
